description: This skill identifies adult childhood cancer survivors with isolated growth hormone deficiency and prior hypothalamic‑pituitary axis radiation exposure who require retesting to confirm persistence of GHD. Triggers include clinician questions such as “Should I retest for GHD in this adult survivor with childhood GHD and radiation history?” or “Is repeat GHD evaluation indicated in this patient?”
